correctness.rationale: Translation by the negative message makes the task an unordered sample without replacement from the M nonzero difference polynomials. For a prescribed t-point set the vanishing constraints leave exactly q^{K−t}−1 nonzero polynomials for t<K and none otherwise. Inclusion–exclusion gives A_r for avoidance on r sites. For a fixed candidate collision set J, applying inclusion–exclusion to the points of J still required to be hit after forbidding E minus J gives the claimed H_j; this also proves invariance, nonnegativity, and normalization. The cap min(T,S(K−1)) is attained by polynomials with disjoint prescribed root blocks and, in the saturated case, padding with distinct polynomials; the root-product factors, unlabeled blocks and nonzero scalars give the exact equality count in the unsaturated case, including S=0. K=1 has no collisions and T=1 needs only a single avoidance probability. Computing indicator covariances using one- and two-site avoidance gives the moments as stated. For fixed K≥2, S=floor(αq) and r=1,2, (M−A_r)/(M−i)=r/q+O(q^−2) uniformly for 0≤i<S as q→∞. Summing the log avoidance factors gives −rα+o(1), so the mean tends to 1−exp(−α) while the variance tends to zero. This is convergence of the coverage fraction, not a Poisson law for the number of collisions. I inspected the prime-field checker and its recorded output (113 grids), without executing the frozen script; the proof applies to prime powers by interpolation.

originality.rationale: The prior tagging proposition already gives the universal upper bound. The best-matching tuple and subcode support enumerators instead aggregate positions where at least one constituent word is nonzero, whereas a tag collision requires at least one constituent word to be zero. The located sources do not supply the distinct-task probability law, unsaturated maximizer count, or typical-task limit. A complete coordinate-pattern enumerator could give the law with further extraction; this is not a claim to a new general enumerator, nor a certification of priority.
residual_risks: A specialized zero-pattern enumerator or older coverage-distribution calculation could encode the same law. The primary and catalogue searches were bounded and did not establish global priority.

value.rationale: For the natural uniform distinct-task ensemble in RS tagging, the full task distribution gives tail frequencies and moments that the universal union bound does not determine. The explicit maximizer count and asymptotic concentration show the gap between typical and worst tasks, e.g. 1−exp(−1) versus one at K=2 and S=q. The claim produces a concrete exact benchmark for that ensemble without extrapolating to arbitrary deterministic tasks.
